proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k E F hij hik hjk
  have hu : ∀ (l m n : Fin 3), l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {l, m, n} := by decide
  intro hE hpE hF hpF
  have orth : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → inner ℝ (t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points l) (t.points m -ᵥ t.points n) = 0 := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn
    have h := t.orthocenter_vsub_circumcenter_eq_sum_vsub
    rw [hu l m n hlm hln hmn, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hlm, hln]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hmn]), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
    have hj := t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius m
    have hk := t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius n
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V] at hj hk
    have e1 : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points l = (t.points m -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points n -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
      rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right t.orthocenter (t.points l) t.circumcenter, h]; abel
    have e2 : t.points m -ᵥ t.points n = (t.points m -ᵥ t.circumcenter) - (t.points n -ᵥ t.circumcenter) :=
      (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
    rw [e1, e2, inner_add_left, inner_sub_right, inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_comm, hj, hk]
    ring
  have thales : ∀ X Y Z : P, inner ℝ (X -ᵥ Z) (Y -ᵥ Z) = 0 → dist Z (midpoint ℝ X Y) = dist X Y / 2 := by
    intro X Y Z h
    have e : Z -ᵥ midpoint ℝ X Y = (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) • ((X -ᵥ Z) + (Y -ᵥ Z)) := by
      rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, midpoint_vsub, invOf_eq_inv]
      module
    have e2 : X -ᵥ Y = (X -ᵥ Z) - (Y -ᵥ Z) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
    have n1 : ‖(X -ᵥ Z) + (Y -ᵥ Z)‖ = ‖(X -ᵥ Z) - (Y -ᵥ Z)‖ := by
      rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), norm_add_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real, h]
      ring
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V Z, e, norm_smul, n1, ← e2, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub]
    norm_num
    ring
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hE
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hF
  have eE1 : t.points k -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points k) (t.points i) r = (-r) • (t.points i -ᵥ t.points k) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vsub_self, zero_sub, neg_smul]
  have eE2 : t.points i -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points k) (t.points i) r = (1 - r) • (t.points i -ᵥ t.points k) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
  have eF1 : t.points i -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) (t.points j) s = (-s) • (t.points j -ᵥ t.points i) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vsub_self, zero_sub, neg_smul]
  have eF2 : t.points j -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) (t.points j) s = (1 - s) • (t.points j -ᵥ t.points i) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
  constructor
  · refine ⟨midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k), dist (t.points j) (t.points k) / 2, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [dist_left_midpoint]; norm_num; ring
    · rw [dist_right_midpoint]; norm_num; ring
    · apply thales
      rw [eE1, inner_smul_right, hpE, mul_zero]
    · apply thales
      rw [real_inner_comm, eF2, inner_smul_right, hpF, mul_zero]
  · refine ⟨midpoint ℝ (t.points i) t.orthocenter, dist (t.points i) t.orthocenter / 2, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [dist_left_midpoint]; norm_num; ring
    · rw [dist_right_midpoint]; norm_num; ring
    · apply thales
      have e : t.orthocenter -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points k) (t.points i) r = (t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points j) + (t.points j -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points k) (t.points i) r) := (vsub_add_vsub_cancel _ _ _).symm
      rw [eE2, e, inner_smul_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_comm (t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points j), real_inner_comm (t.points j -ᵥ _), orth j i k hij.symm hjk hik, hpE]
      simp
    · apply thales
      have e : t.orthocenter -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) (t.points j) s = (t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points k) + (t.points k -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) (t.points j) s) := (vsub_add_vsub_cancel _ _ _).symm
      rw [eF1, e, inner_smul_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_comm (t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points k), real_inner_comm (t.points k -ᵥ _), orth k j i hjk.symm hik.symm hij.symm, hpF]
      simp
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3) (E F : P), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → E ∈ line[ℝ, t.points k, t.points i] → inner ℝ (t.points j -ᵥ E) (t.points i -ᵥ t.points k) = 0 → F ∈ line[ℝ, t.points i, t.points j] → inner ℝ (t.points k -ᵥ F) (t.points j -ᵥ t.points i) = 0 → EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({t.points j, t.points k, E, F} : Set P) ∧ EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({t.points i, t.orthocenter, E, F} : Set P)
